children: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 16, 2026
-- Li-FT Power Ltd. (“
LIFT
” or the “
Company
TSXV: LIFT
ASX: LFT
OTCQX: LIFFF
Frankfurt: WS0
) is pleased to announce the appointment of Olivia Gamache, P.Eng., as Vice President, Sustainability, effective November 16, 2026.

Ms. Gamache brings more than 20 years of experience in environmental management, regulatory affairs, Indigenous and community relations, and sustainability in the mining sector in Canada and internationally. Her experience spans corporate strategy, environmental and regulatory risk management, project permitting and development, and building strong relationships with Indigenous communities, regulators and other stakeholders.

Most recently, Ms. Gamache served as Vice President, Environment and Community at Adventus Mining Corporation, providing strategic leadership across the company’s environmental, regulatory and social performance portfolios and leading the environmental and social impact assessment for the El Domo Project in Ecuador through to regulatory approval. Previously, she held progressively senior roles at Hatch Ltd. and Yamana Gold Inc., supporting more than 20 mining and infrastructure projects and mine sites internationally.
Ms. Gamache holds B.A.Sc. and M.A.Sc. degrees in Chemical Engineering from the University of Toronto and is proficient in French and Spanish.
Jeff Reinson, Chief Operating Officer of LIFT, commented:

“I am deeply pleased to announce Olivia Gamache as our VP of Sustainability. Olivia’s permitting successes, experience, and professionalism will add strength to our team as we build momentum in our development of the Adina Lithium Project and work toward filling the need for lithium in global electrification.”
LIFT Clarifies i2i Marketing Group Engagement

Further to the Company’s release dated October 5, 2026, regarding the engagement of i2i Marketing Group, LLC (“i2i”), the Company clarifies that i2i was engaged pursuant to an online marketing agreement dated October 4, 2026. The agreement term ends March 1, 2027. i2i is a private company based in Key West, Florida, United States led by Kailyn White and Joseph Grubb, dedicated to providing marketing services. The aggregate budget of US$1.4 million is payable in installments reflecting budget costs, with US$250,000 due at each of signing, October 9, 2026 and every two weeks thereafter until November 20, 2026 and a final US$150,000 due on December 15, 2026.

About LIFT

LIFT is a Canadian lithium exploration and development company focused on advancing its flagship Adina Lithium Project and the Renard processing facility in the Eeyou Istchee James Bay region of Québec. The Company is working toward becoming Canada’s next producer of spodumene concentrate by leveraging its large-scale, high-grade lithium resources and the existing infrastructure at Renard, which LIFT holds under an exclusive option to acquire. LIFT also owns the Yellowknife Lithium Project in the Northwest Territories and maintains additional exploration properties in Canada.
